title: The history of the world’s largest fastener distributor
content: # The history of the world’s largest fastener distributor. As World War II slowly came to an end, Adolf Würth knew two things: he needed to support his family and he wanted to work independently. His daughter, Bettina Würth, is the current Chairwoman of the Advisory Board of the Würth Group. So, in the summer of 1945, Würth officially set up his own business — Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG, which became the parent company of today’s Würth Group — selling screws in Künzelsau, Baden-Württemberg (Germany). Although today’s Würth Group is an example of a massive and successful global enterprise, it did not start this way. That was in 1954, when Dr. Würth took over with the support of his mother, Alma Würth, making the Würth Group a two-person company. One part of this global growth includes Würth Industry North America (WINA), which is now a $1 billion division of the Würth Group.

title: FASTENER EXPO FRANKFURT 2026,FASTENER EXPO FRANKFURT
content: # FASTENER EXPO FRANKFURT. **Frankfurt Fastener Expo (FEF) Launches in 2026, Bringing the World’s Fastener Powerhouses to Europe’s Industrial Center. Registration Now Open for Europe’s Most Anticipated New Fastener Trade Fair**. Frankfurt, Germany — A major new event is set to energize Europe’s manufacturing and engineering industries: the Frankfurt Fastener Expo (FEF) will launch 23–25 March 2026 at Messe Frankfurt, uniting the global fastener supply chain at the heart of Europe’s industrial powerhouse. Positioned to become Europe’s central sourcing and innovation platform for fastening and fixing technologies, FEF will bring together 300+ international exhibitors and thousands of professional buyers across automotive, aerospace, machinery, construction, renewable energy, and next-gen manufacturing applications. “FEF is designed to become Europe’s new meeting place for fastener technology—where global manufacturing strength meets Europe’s engineering demand, all in one strategic location,” said Mr. Klaus Liermann, Managing Director for EBSEEK EXHIBITION, the show organizer. Some of the world’s most recognized fastener manufacturers and distributors have already confirmed their exhibiting, underscoring Frankfurt’s importance as Europe’s new fastener hub.
